relations.note: Catachillay and her young appear near Urcuchillay as associated celestial llamas.
Cobo says Catachillay and her young proceeded from Urcuchillay, perhaps by descent or emanation.

relations.myth: The neighboring celestial llama and calf
relations.note: Lehmann-Nitsche conjecturally restored this name for the young llama appearing near Urcuchillay.
Modern comparisons sometimes equate them, but the sources preserve distinct names and celestial forms.
